title: Canonical verdict machine
statement: For each $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and tape index $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(k)$, this is a $k$-work-tape Boolean machine with scan states recording a Boolean value, initially true in the forward phase. In a completed state carrying verdict $b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, it stays in place, leaves every work tape unchanged, outputs $b$, and halts; in all other states it follows the canonical Boolean-scanning machine's transition function.
caveat: The underlying scan-machine transition function is not defined in the supplied statement, so the nonterminal behavior cannot be expanded further.
